title: Analytics Engineer
summary: An analytics engineer turns raw tables in a data warehouse into clean, tested models (ready-to-query tables) that analysts and dashboards rely on, mostly with SQL and dbt. They sit between data engineers, who bring the data in, and analysts and business teams, who use it.
dailyDuties: Build and change dbt models from staging to marts
Write tests and documentation for each model
Agree metric definitions with analysts and business teams
Review pull requests from other analytics engineers
Fix failing dbt runs and data quality alerts
Tune slow models and warehouse costs

skills.expectation: Build and maintain dbt models from staging to marts, with tests and docs
Write clean, well-structured SQL every day
Use window functions and CTEs for metrics and deduplication
Design facts, dimensions and star schemas that analysts can query
Work in Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or a similar warehouse
Add tests and freshness checks so broken data is caught early
Work through pull requests and code review in Git
Turn business questions into agreed metric definitions with analysts and teams
Define metrics once in a semantic layer such as LookML or the dbt Semantic Layer
Use Python for small transformations, tests and tooling
Schedule dbt runs with Airflow or a similar tool
Run dbt builds and tests in CI before merging
Check that models work in the BI dashboards built on them
Understand funnels, retention and revenue metrics

certifications.why: Snowflake is the warehouse most often named in Indian dbt postings
For teams that run dbt on a lakehouse
